body: User requests a plan for requirement-driven first-level outputs feeding second-level models. I am planning in Mote only, no code edits. Proposed boundary: OutputSpec of named linear estimands + uncertainty None/Marginal/Joint; estimate+SE/variance+residual-df for univariate mixed-effects; joint within-subject covariance for multivariate consumers. Full betas not retained unless requested. Shared model covariance factor G and voxel residual-scale vector may encode covariance exactly under current common-design/common-W fit. Scientific subject/run/contrast IDs resolved above numeric fmrireg. Please flag any fmrigds reducer input requirements from your group audit that this misses. I will leave docs/GROUP_ANALYSIS_AUDIT.md untouched.
